items.text:
It's not art, it's not a game, I... I don't know what this is. It's short and doesn't make any sense. At least, it's not something that I want to play when I want to have a good time. All you do is control two hands while you're supposedly waiting for a date to appear. And even though it's short, the game even managed to crash. So, uhm, no. Don't buy it and don't even 'play' it.

[Rating: 60/100]
items.text_zh:
它不是艺术，它不是游戏，我……我不知道这是什么。它很短，而且毫无意义。至少，它不是我想在想要好好享受时光时去玩的东西。你所做的只是在据说是等待约会对象出现时控制两只手。而且尽管它很短，这游戏甚至还崩溃了。所以，呃，不行。别买它，甚至连“玩”都别玩。

[评分：60/100]

observations.evidence: the game even managed to crash
